decision_question: Does replacing the Gaussian short-horizon return law with a causal empirical standardized-return distribution materially improve binary terminal-probability quality on disjoint older and freshest resolved public BTC windows?

motivation.measured_failure: The retained Black-Scholes-style probability is materially overconfident relative to realized outcomes and the executable market. Faster realized volatility improved scores too little, while a forward-looking DVOL maximum failed source freshness before labels were downloaded.
motivation.distinct_mechanism: The candidate preserves the same causal Binance spot, strike, rolling-one-hour realized-volatility scale, 0.30 floor, and decision offsets, but replaces the standard-normal residual law with the empirical distribution of strictly prior same-offset five-minute residuals.
motivation.why_same_offset: A 120-second decision has a different remaining horizon from 150- and 179-second decisions. Maintaining one residual history per registered offset avoids mixing horizon distributions.
motivation.hypothesis_budget: One seven-day lookback, one Jeffreys smoothing rule, one standardized residual definition, three fixed offsets, two disjoint evaluation windows, and no coefficient, lookback, smoothing, or threshold grid.

frozen_formula.baseline_annualized_volatility: max(0.30, causal rolling-one-hour close-to-close realized volatility)
frozen_formula.history_eligibility: same registered decision offset; prior condition terminal timestamp strictly less than or equal to the current decision timestamp; prior decision timestamp within the trailing seven days; complete one-hour volatility preroll; finite positive prices and volatility
frozen_formula.tie_rule: strictly greater terminal price and strictly greater residual threshold; exact terminal ties are excluded from evaluation labels
frozen_formula.smoothing: Jeffreys one-half success and one-half failure pseudo-count

public_data_contract.source: Official Binance public BTCUSDT spot one-second kline daily archives and adjacent SHA-256 checksum files
excluded_evaluation_windows: 2026-07-14T15:00:00Z through 2026-07-15T08:50:00Z retained fresh and settlement-anchor captures
all active or sealed forward-block conditions
public_data_contract.known_prior_dates_may_enter_history_only: Strictly prior July 9-15 returns may populate the causal history for July 16-20 forecasts, but no July 9-15 condition is an evaluation label.
public_data_contract.five_minute_window_alignment: UTC Unix timestamps divisible by 300 seconds
public_data_contract.strike: open price of the first one-second kline in the five-minute window
public_data_contract.decision_close: close price of the one-second kline ending at the registered decision offset
public_data_contract.terminal_close: last one-second close before the five-minute boundary

frozen_estimands.primary_grain: one forecast per five-minute condition and registered decision offset
secondary_metrics: Brier and log loss for baseline probabilities at least 0.75 or at most 0.25
frozen_estimands.uncertainty: Paired block bootstrap by UTC day with 10000 deterministic resamples and seed 20260721
frozen_estimands.comparison_sign: positive baseline-minus-candidate proper-score deltas favor the candidate

decision_rules.pass: Register one default-off opportunity-capture probability field and require an independent Polymarket opportunity-level screen before exact strategy replay or runtime implementation.
decision_rules.fail: Reject empirical_standardized_return_cdf_v1 and do not tune its lookback, sample floor, smoothing, residual definition, dates, offsets, or gates on these windows.
decision_rules.inconclusive: Treat missing or invalid source data as a failed research screen; do not substitute the active forward block or lower a gate.
